title: Quick No-Yeast Naan
ingredients:
• 250g All-purpose flour
• 180g Natural yogurt
• 1.5 tsp Baking powder
• 0.5 tsp Baking soda
• 0.5 tsp Salt
• 1 tbsp Olive oil
• 1-2 tbsp Warm water (if needed)
instructions:
1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly distributed.
2. Make a well in the center of the flour. Add the natural yogurt and olive oil. Stir until a shaggy dough forms.
3. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface. Knead for 2-3 minutes until smooth. Add extra flour 1 tbsp at a time if the dough is too sticky.
4. Cover the dough with the bowl and let it rest for 10 minutes to relax the gluten.
5. Divide the dough into 6 equal portions. Roll each piece into an oval or circle about 1/4 inch thick.
6. Heat a heavy, dry skillet over medium-high heat. Cook one piece of dough for 1 minute until bubbles form, then flip and cook for another 30-45 seconds until charred spots appear.
